unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Screen brightness
drDigitalIntro:
A screen that is too bright is as hard to read as one that is too dim.
• Brightness lives under Display, not Accessibility — but it does the same job.
• Turn it down in a dark room and up near a window.
• If your eyes ache at the end of the day, brightness is usually the first thing to try.
• Common mistake: turning brightness all the way down to save battery, then squinting for an hour.

playgroundTask.goal: You set the screen brightness by hand

steps.say: Click Display in the list on the left.
Drag the Brightness slider down to somewhere between 40 and 60.

drDigitalSuccess: The whole screen dimmed. That is the control to reach for in a dark room.
drDigitalHint: Display is the second item in the left-hand list. Brightness is the slider at the top of it.
